bio: A classically furnished, family-run restaurant with a name inspired by this old form of transport in the city. Enjoy traditional cuisine with a contemporary touch, including the occasional international dish and a tasting menu option. The high quality of ingredients it works with is clearly evident in the fish served here (purchased daily at auction), and dishes such as Galician razor clams with a glaze of Manzanilla sherry (from Sanlúcar) and hazelnuts....
